io.name: clk
io.description: Clock signal; state samples on posedge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Synchronous active-high reset; resets FSM to state A.

io.name: out
io.description: Moore output; 1 only in state D, else 0.

functional_summary.overview: Four-state Moore FSM (A, B, C, D) with one input and one output. Synchronous active-high reset forces state A. Output is 1 only in state D and 0 otherwise. State transitions occur on the rising clock edge.
rules: On posedge clk with reset=1, next state is A.
On posedge clk with reset=0: from A, next state is A if in=0 else B.
From B, next state is C if in=0 else B.
From C, next state is A if in=0 else D.
From D, next state is C if in=0 else B.
Output out is 1 when current state is D, and 0 when current state is A, B, or C.
Output is a Moore output depending only on current state, with zero-cycle latency relative to the state.
